items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: "I said, 'Jo Jones, you’re going to have to go out on the patio and smoke.' And so he went back to New York... I said yes we did."

ctx.x: And sometime he’d stay one week or two weeks, or sometimes a day, bing and he’s gone, or he’s going to see some other musicians like up in San Diego then go to L.A., that type of thing, make his rounds.

He told everybody I put him out because I wouldn’t let him smoke. Well, he was a chain smoker. And I told him I said, “Jo Jones, you’re going to have to go out on the patio and smoke.” And so he went back to New York and we got calls all week long, “You threw Jo Jones out?” “You put Papa Jo out?” I said yes we did.
And then when we got to New York and everything, everybody was still talking about it.
